segments.name: equipment for the highway construction industry
segments.description: Designs and manufactures heavy machinery, including asphalt plants, pavers, combustion systems and fluid heat transfer systems, for highway construction and environmental and petrochemical markets.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reporting segment, equipment for the highway construction industry.

revenueModel.text: Customers, primarily highway construction companies, pay the Company for machinery and related equipment sold through Company sales representatives and independent dealers and agents, plus servicing and spare parts.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's products are manufactured in the United States and sold through a combination of Company sales representatives and independent dealers and agents.

changes.text: In 2020, the Company acquired the asphalt paver assets from Volvo Construction Equipment North America LLC.
changes.evidence: In 2020, the Company acquired the asphalt paver assets from Volvo Construction Equipment North America LLC.
